info.cls_ename: Bachelor's Program of International Business Administration in English

description.describe_ch: 統計學(一)為統計入門課程，從機率概念由淺入深導引學生進入基本統計觀念，瞭解抽樣分配與估計的演算與運用。主題包括資料整理、機率概念、常用之機率分配、抽樣分配、點估計與區間估計。
description.describe_eh: Statistics (1) is the first introductory course in which this text starts from the concepts of probability to elementary statistics in order to understand the computation of sampling distribution and estimation methods. Topics include data management, probability concept, some common probability distributions, sampling distribution, and point and interval estimations.

targets.describe_ch: 能知道何謂統計學之應用與敘述統計學。
targets.describe_en: To know statistical  applications, and descriptive statistics.

targets.describe_ch: This purpose of this course is to provide an introduction to and stimulate discussion of cross-cultural marketing communications and management issues. Additional goals include the analysis of marketing in heterogeneous markets and nations and the conflicts that may arise from these practices. Potential solutions and strategies to avoid and reduce these conflicts will be proposed and discussed.
targets.describe_en: To Know some probability distribution functions and its applications.
